# Research & Scholarly Support

> Research supervision and publication guidance for students and early-career researchers in Bangladesh, China and worldwide. We supervise research studies, turn completed theses into IEEE conference and Q1 journal papers, and support submission and revision. There is no advance payment; fees are agreed in writing and paid only after acceptance. Acceptance is always decided by peer review.

Research supervised by our team has produced 21 published papers, including 12 in Elsevier journals and 8 on IEEE Xplore, with more than 1,600 citations (OpenAlex, October 2026). Co-authors come from 32 universities in 5 countries.

## Services

- [Join a ready-to-submit project](https://research-and-scholarly-support.github.io/#available): join an IEEE conference paper at its final stage, contribute to the remaining work under supervision, and be credited according to your contribution and the venue's authorship policy. Booking a position is free.
- [Join a project from the start](https://research-and-scholarly-support.github.io/#services): reserve a seat on a new supervised study and contribute across literature review, data, experiments, analysis and writing.
- [Thesis to publication](https://research-and-scholarly-support.github.io/#services): turn a completed thesis or dissertation into a journal article or conference paper, with supervision for restructuring, editing, venue selection and submission.

## Research domains

Medical image analysis; clinical and health data science; biomedical signal processing; mental health and social analytics; computer vision and edge AI; explainable AI; natural language processing; environment, agriculture and remote sensing; forecasting and reliability.
